title: The Unprayed Seed Repository

features.name: seeds waiting for speech
features.desc-on-touch: Each seed is a word that has not yet been spoken. The repository holds millions of utterances, dormant, patient. They do not know if they will grow into prayer or weeds or silence.

features.name: the unplanted cache
features.desc-on-touch: Rows of perfect storage, organized for a planting that has not yet been decided. The seeds are organized by weight, color, date of harvest, but not by prayer. That comes later, if it comes at all.

features.name: the covenant undecided
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of growing medium, soil, compost — everything prepared for the moment of utterance. But the utterance has not come. The ground is ready to listen, but the prayer has not begun.

features.name: the witness silence
features.desc-on-touch: A sprite that holds the shape of growth but has not grown. It is the potential form of everything that might rise from the ground. Witness to the moment before words become roots.

features.name: the unspoken glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A symbol carved into a seed coat — not yet a word in any language. Not yet a prayer. The archive holds it carefully, waiting to learn what it means.

reverie.title: REVERIE — in the seed house at first light
narr: You kneel beside her in the dark of the seed house,
your hands in the cool storage, seeds between your fingers.
She says: not yet. The ground's not ready. Not yet
for the words that make things grow. You sit together
in the unspoken morning, holding the seeds like questions

inscription: before growth speaks, all utterance waits in darkness as seed

file.name: Unprayed_Seeds_Catalogue_Before_Speaking.txt
file.note: The repository's ledger — all future growth, waiting for the prayer that will call it into being

exits.label: back toward the field where prayer has already begun
toward the sky where clouds hold their own seeds
toward deeper storage, seeds for times not yet imagined
toward the soil that dreams of breaking open
